correctness.rationale: For \(q=|V\setminus D|=k+t\), a selected vertex in part \(V_i\) has exactly \(q-x_i\) neighbors outside \(D\). Thus the k-limited condition is equivalent to \(d_i\le n_i-t\) on every selected part. Summation gives the stated necessary threshold, and the capacity allocation in the converse constructs an attaining dominating set. The one-vertex boundary is excluded by \(k<\Delta(G)\). The bundled exhaustive verifier checks the defining conditions directly for all complete-multipartite isomorphism types through order 11 and every nontrivial k.

value.rationale: Complete multipartite graphs are a standard structural family containing cliques, stars, bicliques, and Turán graphs. The formula strictly extends the initiating paper's exact biclique result, gives a one-dimensional exact criterion for arbitrary part profiles, and yields the simple balanced law \(rm-k-\lfloor k/(r-1)\rfloor\). This directly addresses the paper's stated direction of determining k-limited domination on additional graph families.
